```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  verify-dco:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify DCO sign-off on all commits
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Get base and head SHAs of the PR
          BASE_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

          echo "Checking commits between $BASE_SHA and $HEAD_SHA"

          # List all non-merge commits in the PR
          COMMITS=$(git rev-list --no-merges $BASE_SHA..$HEAD_SHA)

          MISSING=()

          for COMMIT in $COMMITS; do
            MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B "$COMMIT")
            if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              MISSING+=("$COMMIT")
            fi
          done

          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ The following commits are missing DCO sign-off:" >&2
            for C in "${MISSING[@]}"; do
              echo "  - $C" >&2
            done
            echo >&2
            echo "Please add a Signed-off-by line to each commit message." >&2
            echo "You can amend the commit with:" >&2
            echo "  git commit --amend -s" >&2
            echo "or rebase interactively:" >&2
            echo "  git rebase -i --exec 'git commit --amend -s'" >&2
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All commits have DCO sign-off."
          fi
```
